title_tr: Projeden çıkarılan üyenin görevleri ona atanmış kalıyor
issue: After a member is removed from a project, the tasks that were assigned to them in that project stay assigned to them. They should become unassigned.

ground_truth.root_cause: TaskService.on_member_removed compares task.assignee_id with project_id instead of user_id, so no task ever matches and nothing is unassigned.
